Correction to Trump on Interest Rates Article on Sept. 16

Trump raised the prospect of cutting off trade to countries that have a trade surplus with the U.S. "Trump: Interest Rates Should Be 1% or Less," published at 4:47 p.m. ET on Sept. 16, incorrectly said a trade deficit.
